title: C4OS Grill Question 020 - App Tool Approval Defaults

questions.label: How should C4OS define default approval policy?
questions.help: Recommended: per Tauri tool/app tool, with a default policy and max authority. This matches the existing technical specs and avoids one broad sandbox setting.
options: Per Tauri tool/app tool with default policy and max authority
One global default approval policy for all tools

questions.label: Which first-pass approval categories should exist?
questions.help: Recommended: allow, ask, deny, and remember. This supports simple defaults plus user-approved saved rules.
options: Use Codex approval policy names exactly

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify default choices for browser.open, files.read, files.write, terminal.run, artifact.preview, git/worktree, network tools, or plugin-provided tools.
